name: OctopMemory
description: Pluggable hierarchical memory for OpenClaw — raw events, atom cards, entity pages with FTS5-backed recall.

bridge.python.label: Python interpreter
bridge.python.help: Python ≥3.12 used to spawn the octopmemory-bridge subprocess. Defaults to the octop-memory installed in the same environment.

profile.label: Memory scenario profile
profile.help: Scenario preset: balanced, low_latency, proactive, privacy, archive, or eval. Explicit config values override the profile defaults.

recall.mode.label: Memory prompt mode
recall.mode.help: off = no memory prompt; tool_hint = tools-only hint (default); hybrid = opt into hybrid semantics when the host exposes query context.

backend.label: Storage backend
backend.help: sqlite (default) writes a local file; postgres shares a PostgreSQL cluster across agents. Postgres requires OCTOP_MEMORY_DSN to be set in this process's own environment before the bridge is spawned — never put a DSN in this config, it would leak into process listings.

profile.description: Scenario preset. Profile defaults are applied first; explicit fields in this config override them.

mode.description: Deployment mode. Only 'self-hosted' is supported; the process still owns its own storage (see 'backend' for sqlite vs. shared postgres).

backend.description: Storage engine for this namespace. postgres requires OCTOP_MEMORY_DSN set in the environment of the process that spawns the bridge (inherited by the subprocess automatically) — the DSN must never be placed in this config file, since it embeds a password and config-json is visible in process listings.

db_path.description: SQLite db path. setup always writes it explicitly (default: ~/.openclaw/octopmemory/<namespace>/memory.sqlite — under the OpenClaw home so sandboxed deployments can see it). When unset the bridge falls back to ~/.octopmemory/<namespace>/memory.sqlite, which is invisible inside openclaw-security sandboxes.

namespace.description: Memory namespace identifier. When omitted the plugin builds it as '<host_name>__<user_id_hash[:12]>'.

host_files_root.description: Workspace dir for the D51-C host_files watcher (MEMORY.md / USER.md / DREAMS.md / memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md). Required when capture.host_files_watcher is true; otherwise ignored. Use an absolute path.

host_files_allow.description: Additional relative Markdown globs under host_files_root for user-managed topical memory, for example topics/*.md or projects/*.md. Defaults to topics/*.md and projects/*.md.

command.description: Explicit octopmemory-bridge console-script path (preferred). Set by `setup` from the resolved uv/pipx tool env. When present it is spawned directly and `python` is ignored.

python.description: Python interpreter used to spawn the bridge subprocess via `python -m`. Used only when `command` is unset. Defaults to 'python3'.

spawn_timeout_ms.description: Max wait for the bridge to answer the initial handshake before the plugin gives up.

recall.description: Prompt and search recall behaviour. Some fields are V1 contract only and become runtime-active in V2.

default_max_results.description: Default snippet count for memory_search when the agent omits maxResults.

default_corpus.description: Default corpus for memory_search when omitted.

raw_policy.description: Whether raw transcripts participate in recall: never, fallback, or always.

host_files_policy.description: How host-written MEMORY.md / memory/*.md files participate in recall.

citation_policy.description: Whether the prompt should encourage Source: <path> citations.

max_prompt_chars.description: Character budget for future hybrid auto-recall prompt injection.

limit.description: Legacy alias for default_max_results; kept for v0.2 compatibility.

total_chars.description: Legacy soft cap on total chars returned by memory_search; kept for v0.2 compatibility.

agent_end_hook.description: Capture raw user/assistant messages on the agent_end hook. Default true.

host_files_watcher.description: Watch host-written memory/*.md and MEMORY.md to index host compaction silent-turn output. Default true.

min_message_chars.description: Skip messages shorter than this on the agent_end path.

include_tool_calls.description: Whether to store tool call metadata.

include_tool_results.description: Whether to store tool result content. Usually disabled for privacy.

skip_memory_echo.description: Drop content that echoes the injected ## Memory Recall section, preventing self-pollution.

extract_on_agent_end.description: Trigger L0->L1/L2/L3 extraction (bridge extract) after each agent_end capture. Only takes effect when llm.endpoint is configured. Default true.

privacy.description: Privacy and redaction controls. Some fields are V1 contract only and become runtime-active in V2.

redact_secrets.description: Enable built-in secret/token redaction patterns before storage.

redact_patterns.description: Additional regex patterns to redact before storage.

store_raw_content.description: Whether to store original raw message content.

store_tool_payloads.description: Whether to store tool payloads and results.

compaction.description: Overrides for the host's compaction silent-turn flush plan (D52-C).

enabled.description: When false the plugin returns null from flushPlanResolver and the host falls back to its default plan.

soft_threshold_tokens.description: Token budget that triggers the compaction silent turn (default 4000, mirrors memory-core).

force_flush_transcript_bytes.description: Transcript byte size that forces a compaction flush regardless of token count (default 2 MiB).

model.description: Optional model override for the silent flush turn (e.g. 'ollama/qwen3:8b').

host_file_index_after_flush.description: Whether host flush output is expected to be indexed by host_files watcher.
